title: H2 response-header timeout can drop the only ResponseFuture and make the session panic on retry
notes: read_response_header takes resp_fut out of the session (Option::take) and awaits it under read_timeout; the timeout drops the only ResponseFuture and a retry panics. Taken value -> dropped_future; request in flight -> in_progress. Fixed in 6dcc236.

title: `try_join_all` can drop a shard worker-restart future after workers are stopped, leaving the local shard update handler stopped
notes: try_join_all (fail-fast join -> select) drops a sibling after wait_workers_stops() took the update receiver but before run_workers(); the shard's update pipeline stays stopped for later updates. Taken receiver -> dropped_future. Fixed by #9671.

title: LocalSet drop impl panics when dropped with unfinished futures
notes: Dropping a LocalSet holding unfinished futures panicked ('tasks should only be completed locally'); scheduler-internal. Fixed by #1843.

title: fix(iroh-gossip): connection loop misuses `tokio::select!` leading to read errors
notes: select! over read_message aborted mid-message; the next iteration read body bytes as a length, dropping connections. The read position lives in the dropped future. Merged fix.

title: No-op ALTER SINK can restart KV log reader without rewind and panic
notes: A no-op UpdateConfig select! branch cancels consume_log_and_sink; the outliving KV log reader is left mid-read (not Reset) and the next sinker's start_from panics. User-observed; fixed by #26412/#26484.

title: make simple source cancel safe
notes: tick() (sleep, then lock and send) is recreated every select! iteration; a busy source keeps resetting the sleep before anything is taken, so progress stalls (confirmed by the #10971 discussion). Merged fix #12714.

title: Queue-proxifying a local shard can drop the shard if the transfer future is cancelled after `local.take()`
notes: local.take() then awaiting queue-proxy construction; cancel_on_token (select!) drops the future owning the LocalShard, leaving replica_set.local=None. Taken value -> dropped_future. Whitebox test; maintainers labelled it accepted.

title: persist: make Pending cancel safe
notes: block_until_ready mem::replaces the state with a placeholder and awaits the taken JoinHandle; if dropped there, later into_result panics. The taken handle -> dropped_future; the spawned write continues. Merged with a test.

title: fix(log-store): ensure cancellation safety for log reader next_item call
notes: next_item() pops a flushed item from the buffer, then reads its chunk; losing the select! against the delivery future drops the popped item. Merged fix #12725.

title: fix(storage): Move timeout layer before to ensure cancel safety
notes: The timeout layer sat outside RuntimeLayer, so a timeout dropped only the waiter while the op kept running on the IO-runtime task and the retry re-entered it (mechanism inferred from the diff; low confidence). Merged #17902.

title: Break from deferred points wait when caller times out
notes: A client timeout drops the feedback oneshot receiver; the sequential update worker keeps waiting for deferred points, blocking later updates on the shard. Merged #8680.

title: pageserver management API doesn't poll request handlers to completion if client hangs up [P:1] [S:1]
notes: A client hang-up drops the detach handler after the tenant moved to Stopping in place; the tenant stays Stopping and later detaches fail. Prod issues cited; fixed by #4314.

title: layer: evict downloaded-but-not-initialized
notes: get_or_maybe_download dropped after the layer file was downloaded but before LayerInner was initialized: effect on disk unrecorded -> effect_unrecorded; the initialization duty lived in the dropped future. Fixed by #7030.

title: Dropping HTTP/2 response future doesn't cancel request body send and does not send RST_STREAM
notes: Dropping the h2 response future (timeout) leaves the spawned pipe_task holding SendStream; no RST_STREAM, flow-control window held against other streams. Runnable test; fixed by #4042.

title: fs: add support for non-threadpool executors
notes: codebook-gap: a defect caught in review inside the PR that introduced the code (never released). The new blocking pool did tx.send(f()).unwrap(), which panics if the awaiting future was dropped before the blocking work finished; fixed within #1495 by ignoring the send error.

title: `tokio::io::simplex` read/write data not equality
notes: The user's select! cancels write_all after part of PATTERN was written (effect delivered, progress unrecorded); the retried write_all starts over, so the stream is misaligned. Maintainer diagnosis.

title: Keep consensus operation awaiters alive for concurrent waiters
notes: After a waiter's timeout, cleanup removed the shared broadcast entry, failing other waiters of the still-in-flight consensus op; timed-out batch awaiters leaked. 4 regression tests, merged #10338.

title: proxy http cancellation safety
notes: hyper drops the handler on client disconnect while the SQL query keeps running in Postgres; a retry then hits a duplicate key. Merged with a regression test (#7117).

title: Avoid socket thrash
notes: When pool checkout wins the select, the in-progress connect future is dropped and its half-established socket goes into TIME_WAIT (socket thrash under load). Fixed by #1585.

title: Spawn a task to run services_ensure
notes: A client timeout drops services_ensure mid-way; zones stay partially configured and absent from existing_zones (state behind a mutex), so the next PUT fails. Observed #3098; merged #3140.

title: file descriptor leak
notes: timeout drops a tokio::fs read whose blocking read on a device never returns; File's drop waits, so the fd is never closed and fds exhaust. Maintainer confirmed.

title: stdin: first line intermittently lost from Deno.stdin.readable on Unix (orphaned cancelled blocking read)
notes: Deno's op CancelHandle drops the stdin read future, but the spawn_blocking read(0) remains in flight and later eats the next line. Member-filed with a proof program.

title: RTCache lookup cancellation can leave same-key requests blocked on a stale coalescing lock
notes: RTCache::get publishes a zero-permit lock in the shared lockers map, then awaits lookup; a drop skips cleanup and same-key readers wait forever. Labelled bug; whitebox test.

title: cluster: avoid accidentally dropping TimelyContainer
notes: ClusterClient takes TimelyContainer out of the shared Arc and awaits; a gRPC disconnect drops it, and its Drop blocks a tokio thread forever. Incident; merged #29221.

title: Add test for broken WAL delta after stream records abort
notes: During a stream-records transfer the receiver's last-seen clocks already record updates; aborting the transfer leaves clocks ahead of the data, so the WAL-delta retry skips it. Merged test + fix #7791.

title: sync: wake mpsc receiver when a queued `reserve[_many]` returns permits
notes: A dropped reserve_many returns partially acquired permits without waking the closed channel's receiver, so recv() hangs. Merged #8260 with tests.

title: Strange issue with tokio::select and MultiplexedConnection
notes: select! drops xread_options(BLOCK 0) after the request was sent; the server keeps blocking the multiplexed connection and later commands stall. Explained by collaborators with the reporter's repro.

title: bug: AsyncSinker can mark finish complete before awaited on_finish work completes
notes: called_on_finish is set before on_finish().await; dropping mid-finish makes the sinker's Drop fallback skip on_finish. Flag recorded ahead -> recorded_ahead. Fixed by #20021.

title: Leakage of futures with pending notification on runtime drop
notes: On runtime drop a task with a pending notification was leaked without running Drop, deadlocking tokio-signal. Maintainer-confirmed PoC; threadpool fix #649.

title: Meta: hummock timer task panics during shutdown when a child loop is cancelled, tripping CI's `panicked at` check
notes: shutdown_background() aborts detached child loops; the supervisor's unbiased select! sees JoinError::Cancelled and panics. CI flake; fixed by #26221.

title: connection: wake 'stopped' streams on stream finish events
notes: A dropped Stopped future left its waker in the connection's stopped map until the connection closed (memory growth). Merged quinn#1458.

title: Cancelled io-uring open futures leak fds
notes: A dropped io-uring open marks the op Cancelled; the open completes later in the kernel and its fd is discarded unclosed. PoC; fixed.

title: `tokio::sync::Mutex` appears to be acquired multiple times without being released
notes: select! cancels read() mid read_exact; bytes consumed into the dropped buffer desync framing and the server panics. Maintainer diagnosis of the user's code.

title: [proxy]: BatchQueue::call is not cancel safe - make it directly cancellation aware
notes: The batch leader removed followers' jobs from the queue (taken -> dropped_future) and is cancelled before sending responses; followers fail. Merged #12345.

title: Internal `grpc-timeout` can cancel receiver shard initialization after `local.take()`, leaving the target replica without a local shard slot
notes: init_empty_local_shard does local.take() then awaits; tonic grpc-timeout drops it, leaving the slot None. Taken value -> dropped_future. Labelled accepted; regression-test PR.

title: storage-controller: retains futures during recv
notes: recv rebuilt select_all over replica recv() each poll and dropped it at the end of the poll before anything was taken; a recv that yields first never completes. Merged hotfix #28956.

title: fix(storage): fix panics caused by merge iter future cancellation
notes: Dropping merge-iterator next() drops a live PeekMut whose Drop re-sifts the heap over an inconsistent iterator -> panic. Merged #6985 for #6972.

title: bug: HTTP pagination retry can lose a spilled result page if request is cancelled during restore
notes: try_take_page pops a spilled page then awaits restore; a dropped request loses the popped page (taken -> dropped_future), so the page retry fails. Fixed by #20016.

title: Streaming partial cache reads can treat a cancelled cache writer as clean EOF
notes: A cancelled miss-handler writer drops before finish(); an attached partial reader sees clean EOF and serves a truncated body to another request. Labelled bug; whitebox test.

title: network/sync: Fix justification response lost on peer disconnect
notes: On sync-peer disconnect, pending_responses.remove_all drops the in-flight justification response future; the response from the peer is lost. #5414 by a maintainer; PR with a regression test.

title: fix(aws_s3 source): complete in-flight SQS message processing before shutdown
notes: The shutdown branch of select! drops run_once after events reached sinks but before the SQS delete (effect delivered, unrecorded), so messages are redelivered. Duplicates reported; PR with tests.

title: Cancelling a hashless asset download can persist and reuse an incomplete cache entry
notes: Ctrl-C aborts the download mid-write; the truncated file already at the canonical cache path is an unrecorded effect and a later run accepts it. Whitebox reproducer.

title: compute: make `SequentialHydration::recv` cancel safe
notes: SequentialHydration::recv may call a non-cancel-safe send while scheduling dataflows; cancelling recv drops a half-sent command. Merged #28816.

title: Task dropped in wrong thread when aborting LocalSet task
notes: abort on an idle LocalSet task drops the future on the aborting thread (a !Send value dropped cross-thread). RUSTSEC-2021-0072; fixed #3934.

title: StarRocks sink can lose transaction rollback ownership if checkpoint commit is cancelled during prepare or commit
notes: barrier(true) takes curr_txn_label, then awaits prepare/commit at StarRocks; a drop loses the only label so Drop/abort cannot roll back. Taken label -> dropped_future. Whitebox test only (low confidence).

title: fix(mysql-cdc): use connection pool to avoid data loss caused by unsafe cancellation
notes: Dropping mysql_async exec_drop mid-query leaves the connection mid-protocol; later reads return empty, so backfill ends early (data loss). Timeout repro; merged #22128.

title: tokio::process::Command leaves zombies when child future is dropped
notes: Dropping a Child future with kill_on_drop kills the process but never waits for it; the exit completes in the kernel afterwards and leaves a zombie. Maintainer-confirmed; #2907.

title: storage: abort sink task when dataflow is dropped
notes: Dropping a sink dataflow does not stop the spawn_blocking Kafka scan; restarts pile up scans until OOM. Incident #56; merged #26190.

title: Shard snapshot transfer cancellation can leave source-side transfer snapshots behind
notes: The shard snapshot is persisted before its TempPath cleanup guard exists (codebook example); a cancel_on_token drop leaves it on disk. Accepted by a maintainer; whitebox test.

title: Tokio select! Macro Issue with Barrier
notes: Dropping Barrier::wait in select! after its arrival was counted in place; the next wait double-counts. Maintainer confirmed; documented #6494.

title: Avoid sending new messages before connection finishes
notes: A reconnect cancelled partway leaves the client partially connected; send() delivers old-cluster commands to the new cluster, crashing it. Merged #12485.

title: The first terminal event is ignored after using `stdin`
notes: timeout drops a tokio stdin read; the blocking read stays in flight and consumes the next keypress. Maintainer confirmed.

title: Prevent basic_scheduler from panicking if a task is aborted from another thread
notes: JoinHandle::abort from another thread panicked the basic scheduler ('scheduler context missing'). Merged #3672.

title: S3 streaming multipart uploads can be leaked when a cancelled uploader is dropped after multipart upload starts
notes: The multipart upload is created on S3 (codebook example) but only the dropped uploader knows its upload_id; the abort never happens. Whitebox test only.

title: Corrupt connections
notes: A timeout drops query_async after the request was written (effect delivered, reply not recorded as pending); the next command on the reused connection reads the stale reply. Runnable repro; collaborator confirmed.

title: [wicketd] make installinator_progress cancel safe
notes: report_progress advanced RunningUpdate (possibly to Closed) before sending the report; cancelling there loses the report while state says handled. Found in review; merged #3579.

title: fix(ext/http): don't panic on stream responses in cancelled requests
notes: A force-closed TCP connection makes hyper drop the request future, which drops the body resource while the OpState lock is held -> panic. Merged #20316.

title: fix(iroh): get rid of flume channels
notes: Cancelling a flume recv_async in select! loses the wakeup notification, stalling actors whose only source is the channel. External reproducer; iroh replaced flume.

title: Hyper returns a partial byte array when its runtime is closed mid-read
notes: Dropping the runtime drives the HTTP/1 dispatcher's drop mid-body; the body Sender drops cleanly and the reader in another runtime gets a truncated body as Ok. Repro; fixed #4069.

title: fix(walreceiver): Timeline::shutdown can leave a dangling handle_walreceiver_connection tokio task
notes: During shutdown, select! drops connection_manager_loop_step inside drop_old_connection, leaving a walreceiver task running after Timeline shutdown. Merged #7235.

title: ClickHouse sink checkpoint cancellation can drop insert finalization ownership before log truncation
notes: barrier(true) takes the ClickHouse inserter and awaits end(); the rebuild branch wins and drops the finalizer before log truncation, so replay may duplicate. Whitebox test only (low confidence).

title: Make update API cancel safe
notes: A client disconnect drops the update future mid fan-out to shards; some replicas apply and others do not (inconsistency). Merged #3367.

title: Cooperative shutdown in support bundles
notes: Cancelling the collection future while tokio::fs writes are in flight lets writes land after the temp dir is dropped, failing cleanup. CI flake #10063; merged #10204.

title: sync: fix possible dangling pointer in semaphore
notes: A dropped semaphore acquire future whose waiter was already split into the notify list dangles; the added test segfaults. Merged #2340.

title: Deadlock with tokio 1.7.0
notes: Runtime shutdown drops a task from inside a waker call while h2 holds its mutex; the Drop re-locks -> deadlock. Reproduced; fixed in tokio#3870.

title: Subrequest response finish can lose the terminal Done task if cancelled under channel backpressure
notes: finish() sets BodyMode::Complete before sending Done; a cancel under backpressure drops Done and the retry is a no-op. Whitebox test.

title: lru: future cancellation or not polled will lead to deadlock
notes: The first lookup_dedup caller owns the in-flight fetch that others wait on; dropping it leaves waiters stuck. Merged #3911 with a drop scenario.

title: Cancelled search requests remain in SearchQueue and can cause spurious TooManySearchRequests
notes: A cancelled search drops its receiver after its Sender went to the scheduler task, which keeps the stale entry and rejects live requests. Labelled bug; whitebox test.

title: sync: reset Chan::rx_waker in chan::Rx's Drop impl
notes: An aborted task's Receiver drops, but Chan::rx_waker keeps its waker, pinning the task allocation. Merged #8095 with a test.

title: Fix case where cancelled future would be leaked and add a regression …
notes: abort() followed by an immediate handle drop did not drop the cancelled future promptly. Merged #3965 for #3964.

title: proxy_instance_serial_ws() uses `select!` with non-cancel-safe future(s)
notes: select! drops SinkExt::send holding an item, or recv() after it pulled a message, losing serial-console data. Maintainer confirmed; fixed in #3411/propolis#435.

title: bug: Stage Lance COPY can leave target data files without a manifest after query cancellation
notes: Lance data files are written to the target before fragments/manifest are recorded; the finish-notify select drops the processor, leaving visible files without a manifest. Fixed #20050.

title: server serial task's send-to-listeners future is not cancel-safe
notes: The send-to-listeners future may already have delivered to some listeners (unrecorded) when another branch wins; the next iteration resends. Observed by an Oxide engineer.

title: select! with I/O read branch blocks program from exit
notes: select! drops a stdin read, but its blocking read stays in flight and runtime shutdown waits for it, so the program cannot exit. Maintainer confirmed.

title: make `read_exact_at` cancel-safe
notes: Dropping read_exact_at during an in-flight io_uring read would free the fd under the kernel; an interim scopeguard aborted the process. Merged #6101.

title: page_service: `throttle()` is not actually cancel-safe (low impact)
notes: Dropping throttle() between its accounting points leaves started/finished counters unbalanced (in-place state). Maintainer statement.

title: Split `Controller::recv` into `ready` and `process`
notes: Controller::recv in the coordinator select! did cancel-unsafe processing after receiving, so a dropped recv could lose the response. Merged #12479 (consequence inferred).

title: Async-truncate sinks can lose delivery futures when cancellation happens during capacity backpressure
notes: Kafka accepted the record (effect) but its delivery future was not yet registered when the rebuild branch won; replay resends. Whitebox test only (low confidence).

title: HTTP2 requests waiting an outstanding connecting task should not be canceled when the connecting task is canceled
notes: The shared connecting task is driven by the first request's ResponseFuture; dropping it cancels the connect and other waiters fail with Canceled. Maintainer agreed; test in the issue.

title: Abort pending blocking search tasks when we drop/invalidate the search
notes: Dropping timed-out searches dropped only JoinHandles; queued spawn_blocking searches still ran, holding segments for over an hour. Merged #7530.
